title: Ultimate List of Marketing Automation Platforms for 2023 - Builderall Blog

facts.fact: A HubSpot Blog citation, as quoted by this page, says studies find around 56% of businesses currently use marketing automation tools.
facts.quote: studies cite around 56% of businesses currently use the technology, and that number continues to grow.

facts.fact: The page defines marketing automation as the use of software tools and technologies designed to automate repetitive marketing tasks.
facts.quote: Marketing automation refers to the use of software tools and technologies designed to automate repetitive marketing tasks.

facts.fact: The page states that Marketo was acquired by Adobe and is tailored for medium to large businesses.
facts.quote: Acquired by Adobe, Marketo is a comprehensive solution tailored for medium to large businesses.

facts.fact: The page states that Pardot (by Salesforce) is designed for B2B companies.
facts.quote: Designed for B2B companies, Pardot offers advanced lead management and scoring.

facts.fact: The page describes Mailchimp as initially an email marketing tool that has expanded to include automation, landing pages, and postcards.
facts.quote: Initially an email marketing tool, Mailchimp has expanded its offerings to include automation, landing pages, and even postcards.

facts.fact: The page describes SendinBlue as a platform combining email marketing, SMS campaigns, and marketing automation, catering to both small businesses and large enterprises.
facts.quote: A platform that combines email marketing, SMS campaigns, and marketing automation, SendinBlue is known for its simplicity and scalability, catering to both small businesses and large enterprises.

facts.fact: The article states that most marketing automation platforms offer free trials or demos.
facts.quote: Most platforms offer free trials or demos. Make use of these to test the platform's features and assess its suitability for your business.
